# Pinned pi-ai OAuth copy

Source: `@earendil-works/pi-ai@0.84.4`, https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/tree/main/packages/ai, distributed under the MIT license in `docs/licenses/pi-ai-oauth.txt`. Regenerate with `node scripts/vendor-codex-oauth.mjs --write` using the pinned development dependency; without that flag it verifies the exact source and patch without writing.

The local patches close accepted callback HTTP connections and await server closure, and preserve a structured `invalid_grant` refresh rejection as a secret-free error. Only HTTP 400/401 JSON responses with `error: "invalid_grant"` establish that rejection; other failures remain unclassified at this layer. Codex Connect uses this copy for login and refresh. Model catalogs, model requests, refresh scheduling, write locking and credential commit remain with the host pi-ai and plugin credential store. No host dependency files or global HTTP methods are patched. Retire the corresponding patches when a verified upstream release provides awaited callback closure and structured refresh failures and passes the socket and authentication regressions.
